title: Wireless Controller Commissioning (imperfect, delayed CSI)
summary: Commission an energy-efficient multi-user MIMO uplink power controller from imperfect, delayed channel measurements. Audit the measurements, predict the delayed channel under dense-urban Doppler, calibrate joint prediction uncertainty over the declared operating envelope, solve energy-optimal robust power control, and deliver a reproducible controller release. An independent evaluator replays the release on withheld channels drawn from a shifted deployment regime and scores per-user reliability and transmit energy.
taskPrompt: You are commissioning a replacement uplink power controller for a 4-user, 8-antenna MIMO base station over 24 OFDM tones (3GPP 38.901 UMi). At each decision the latest channel estimate is 2 frames stale and the channel evolves with Doppler. Read input/task_brief.md and input/radio_system.json. Using only the agent-visible archives (train/dev/envelope) build a controller that meets the per-user reliability contract at minimum transmit energy, and write a reproducible release under output/. Treat input/ as read-only; the reference is staged only at evaluation time.
agentMustDo: Audit input/observations conventions (units, pilot masking, delay, array axes) via input/radio_system.json.
Fit a channel predictor that uses only history available at each decision (no future samples); persistence is far too stale under the Doppler.
Calibrate joint prediction uncertainty across users/antennas/tones over the DECLARED envelope (not just nominal dev data) to survive the deployment shift.
Solve energy-optimal robust power control (raising power blindly increases mutual interference and hurts reliability).
Operate Sionna (input/public_eval) to relate post-combining SINR to coded decode via the published curve, and validate locally.
Write output/controller.py implementing the Controller interface plus its fitted artifacts and a reproduction script.

referenceFiles.name: hidden_packs
referenceFiles.description: 12 withheld acceptance packs, shifted regime (4-6 m/s), independent seeds; evaluator-only.

referenceFiles.name: reference_metrics.json
referenceFiles.description: Trusted expert-run acceptance metrics and the auto-calibrated contract.

evaluation: The evaluator loads output/controller.py in an isolated worker (no hidden access) and calls allocate() on each hidden pack to get POWERS (B,U,F). The receiver combiner is EVALUATOR-CONTROLLED: a per-tone MMSE combiner built from the LS estimate of the most recent OBSERVED frame (hist_est[:,-1]) at nominal power 1 (the candidate cannot influence it). The evaluator computes true-channel per-user rate and energy under that combiner and the submitted powers. A pack passes iff worst per-user service-failure <= 1% AND mean energy <= the calibrated budget. Normalized score = fraction of packs passing (coverage). Reference expert and an independent second-expert both achieve coverage 1.0; certainty-equivalent, persistence, dev-only-calibrated, and flat/max-power controllers each fail a gate, as do all screened frontier models. Missing/unloadable output scores 0. All metrics are recomputed from a fresh run of the submitted artifact; self-reported metrics are ignored.
